title: Dóru app settings

$schema.description: Reference to the settings schema; enables autocompletion and validation in editors that understand JSON Schema.

provider.description: Active provider preset id, e.g. "ollama" or "acp". Any string is accepted: ids the running version does not know fall back to the default provider instead of invalidating the file. "acp" spawns an Agent Client Protocol agent (see "providers") instead of calling an HTTP API.

providers.description: Settings per provider, keyed by provider id. The app reads the entry of the active provider ("provider" above); the other entries keep their values and are restored when switching back.

baseUrl.description: API base URL. Empty means the preset's default endpoint. Ignored for provider "acp".

model.description: Model name. Empty means the preset's first default model. Ignored for provider "acp".

reasoning.description: Reasoning level for models that support it, translated to each provider's native mechanism (reasoning_effort on OpenAI-style APIs, Anthropic thinking controls). Any string is accepted: levels the running version does not know, or the selected model does not offer, fall back to the provider default. Absent means the provider default. Ignored for provider "acp".

command.description: For provider "acp" only: the agent binary to spawn.

args.description: For provider "acp" only: arguments for the agent command.

additionalProperties.description: Settings of one AI provider. Keys are provider ids.

ai.description: AI provider settings for the agent chat.

theme.description: Theme id: the file name (without the .json extension) of a bundled theme or of a file in <userData>/themes. Defaults to "doru". The operating system appearance decides which palette applies.

description: Settings for the Dóru desktop app (settings.json in the app's data directory). The file is JSONC — comments are allowed and changes are picked up live while the app is running. Defaults live in the app; the file only records explicit overrides, which the app writes when settings change.
